{{Quote|You went back to get this? Just to get this?|Aryn Leneer, to T7-O1|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] both in training and in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], up until the moment of his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Trailer" /> '''Master Zallow's lightsaber''' was of greater heft and length than that of his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Aryn Leneer]], who later acquired and kept the weapon after it was discovered in the rubble of the leveled [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by Zallow's [[T7-O1]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="Deceived" /> Both Master<ref name="Trailer" /> and apprentice&mdash;the latter of whom in the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] style&mdash;used the lightsaber on different occasions against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], the same [[Gender/Legends|man]] who killed Zallow while Coruscant itself was [[Sacking of Coruscant|laid to waste]].<ref name="Deceived" />
